foodSuspensionMatrices.name: Diced Vegetable Minestrone Soup in Light Tomato Broth (10 mm Carrot, Potato & Celery Cubes)
foodSuspensionMatrices.foulingTendency: Low (Vegetable Cellulosic Fiber, Minimal Thermal Denaturation)
foodSuspensionMatrices.description: Particulate vegetable suspension where liquid carrier conductivity slightly exceeds particulate conductivity (Γ = 0.76). Particulate cores experience mild thermal conduction lag from the surrounding volumetrically heated broth.

foodSuspensionMatrices.name: Fortified Dairy Milk & Whey Protein Concentrate Shake (2.8% Protein, Calcium Enriched)
foodSuspensionMatrices.foulingTendency: High (Beta-Lactoglobulin Denaturation & Calcium Phosphate Precipitation above 78°C)
foodSuspensionMatrices.description: Homogeneous dairy emulsion subject to thermal protein aggregation and calcium phosphate fouling at electrode interfaces if laminar boundary layer stagnation occurs.

foodSuspensionMatrices.name: Acidified Fruit Puree with Mango & Peach Pieces (Low-Conductivity Solids in Citric Acid Liquid)
foodSuspensionMatrices.foulingTendency: Moderate (Pectin Gelling & High Soluble Solids Sugar Caramelization)
foodSuspensionMatrices.description: Severe particulate conductivity disparity (Γ = 0.33). Current preferentially bypasses dense fruit pieces, making particle centers the critical microbial cold spot requiring prolonged thermal holding for commercial sterility.

foodSuspensionMatrices.name: Braised Beef & Mushroom Stew in Savory Gravy (High-Conductivity Meat Chunks in Low-Salt Gravy)
foodSuspensionMatrices.description: Inverse particulate conductivity ratio (Γ = 1.55). Electric current preferentially concentrates into meat pieces, causing particulates to heat faster than the surrounding carrier fluid—a phenomenon unique to continuous ohmic processing.
